args.sql:
SELECT 
    p.growalias AS plant_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cleaning_triggers,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(e.soillosspct) AS numeric), 4) AS avg_soiling_loss
FROM environment e
JOIN plant p ON e.arearegistry = p.growregistry
WHERE e.soillosspct > 5 OR e.dustdengm2 > 0.15
GROUP BY p.growalias;
